title: Race and Gender in LLM-Generated Personas: A Large-Scale Audit of 41 Occupations

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting large language models to generate occupational personas and comparing the gender distributions of the generated profiles across 41 U.S. occupations against U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) demographic baselines using logistic regression to measure systematic shifts and stereotype exaggeration.

Prompting large language models to generate occupational personas and comparing the racial and ethnic distributions (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) of the generated profiles across 41 U.S. occupations against U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) demographic baselines using logistic regression to measure systematic shifts and stereotype exaggeration.
